item.title: NVIDIA Launches RTX Spark Platform with DLSS 5 and Nemotron 3.5 AI Model
item.description:
NVIDIA Launches RTX Spark Platform with DLSS 5 and Nemotron 3.5 AI Model

NVIDIA introduced RTX Spark, a new Windows PC platform that combines a Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU for AI development, creation, and gaming in slim laptops and compact desktops.

🔧 Platform Details

  • Powered by an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and NVIDIA Grace CPU.
  • Supports up to 128 GB of unified memory.
  • Runs the full NVIDIA CUDA stack and RTX technologies, including ray tracing and DLSS 5.
  • Includes the updated NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 plugin for Unreal Engine 5.8 with official Windows on Arm (WoA) support.
  • Native ARM64 binaries allow developers to build and package UE 5.8 applications for RTX Spark systems.

🎮 DLSS 5 Features

Technology Description
Super Resolution Reconstructs frames from a lower‑resolution input to improve performance.
Ray Reconstruction Generates additional pixels to enhance ray‑traced scenes.
Dynamic Multi Frame Generation Can generate up to five additional frames per rendered frame; the multiplier adjusts automatically to maximize smoothness.
3D‑Guided Neural Rendering Supported on RTX Spark starting with NBA 2K27.
  • DLSS 5 adds a final stage to the graphics pipeline that enhances lighting and material detail while keeping the engine‑rendered frame as the foundation.
  • Avalanche Software used DLSS 5’s SDK controls to preserve artistic intent in their game.
  • The latest NVIDIA app beta adds a faster Performance Mode (Preset C) for Frame Generation with minor image‑quality trade‑offs.
  • An October model update runs 2× faster than the September version, halves GPU overhead, and reduces VRAM usage at 4K by 20% while keeping comparable visual fidelity.
  • The model will ship by default in future DLSS 5 games.

🤖 In‑Game AI with Nemotron 3.5

  • Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4 GB is now available.
  • Provides ~40 % higher average quality against the prior model on relevant benchmarks.
  • Produces up to ~80 % fewer tokens compared with peers.
  • Engineered for maximum intelligence and speed per GB of memory, enabling responsive local experiences while preserving headroom for graphics rendering and local speech models.
  • Designed to power richer, faster in‑game character interactions with strong conversational capability, autonomous multi‑turn tool use, instruction adherence, and grounding to game state.
  • Features a Conversational mode toggle for concise, speech‑ready responses.
  • Configurable reasoning lets developers enable or disable reasoning to meet latency targets.

🚀 Performance Improvements

  • On supported GeForce RTX 50 Series and RTX PRO Blackwell GPUs, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation adapts the frame‑generation multiplier as workloads change, with a 6× Multi Frame Generation producing up to five additional frames per rendered frame.
  • The October model update halves GPU overhead and cuts VRAM use at 4K by 20%.

📦 Availability

  • RTX Spark ships with the full CUDA stack, DLSS 5 support, and the updated DLSS 4.5 plugin for Unreal Engine 5.8.
  • Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4 GB runs locally on GeForce RTX and RTX Spark devices.
  • Early‑access integrations, such as NBA 2K27, already showcase DLSS 5 on RTX Spark.
  • Wider rollout to future DLSS 5 titles is planned.

#NVIDIA #DLSS5 #AIModels #Gaming #RTXSpark

Source: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games | NVIDIA Technical Blog

item.title: Toned-Down DLSS 5 To Debut In Games Soon
item.description:
Toned-Down DLSS 5 To Debut In Games Soon

Nvidia’s toned-down DLSS 5 is poised for upcoming game debuts, alongside key performance and model updates.

🔍 Key DLSS 5 Revisions

  • Toned down from its earlier-this-year showcase, with face and environmental changes as subtle as those in NBA 2K27
  • Teenagers no longer look like middle-aged men
  • October update shrinks the model footprint by 24 percent to roughly 118 million parameters (per Nvidia’s Andrew Burnes)
  • October update reduces 4K VRAM usage by 20 percent (per Nvidia’s Andrew Burnes)
  • October update makes DLSS 5 twice as fast on RTX 50-series GPUs and upcoming RTX Spark laptops

🚀 Availability Details

  • Toned-down DLSS 5 debuts in Hogwarts Legacy on November 5th
  • Toned-down DLSS 5 comes to Where Winds Meet late next month
  • The new DLSS 5 model from the October update debuts first in NBA 2K27 on October 16th
  • The new DLSS 5 model ships by default with future DLSS 5 games
  • Nvidia maintains developers have “detailed artistic control” over DLSS 5 implementation

⚙️ Supplementary Nvidia App Update

  • New Nvidia app beta update includes a faster performance mode for Frame Generation on RTX 40- and 50-series GPUs
  • Updated AI model uses a “faster and lighter algorithm to boost frame rates” for Frame Gen, Multi Frame Gen, and Dynamic Multi Frame Gen
  • Nvidia states the performance mode has “minor trade‑offs in image quality”
  • Nvidia states the performance mode for Frame Generation is up to 35 percent faster

#DLSS5 #Nvidia #HogwartsLegacy #WhereWindsMeet #NBA2K27 #FrameGeneration

Source: DLSS 5 gets toned down for its Hogwarts Legacy debut next month

item.title: Nvidia Launches DLSS 5 for RTX 50-Series GPUs and NBA 2K27
item.description:
Nvidia Launches DLSS 5 for RTX 50-Series GPUs and NBA 2K27

Nvidia is officially launching DLSS 5 this week, an AI upscaling technology the company described as its most significant breakthrough in computer graphics since real-time ray tracing debuted in 2018.

🧩 How it works

Nvidia stated that DLSS 5 provides developers with controls and sliders to determine how changes appear in their games. Capabilities include:

  • The ability to choose which parts of a scene to enhance.
  • The option to enhance specific elements like foliage, food, or silverware while leaving characters’ faces alone.
  • Support for 6x frame generation, where the game produces one “real” frame for every six frames displayed.

⚙️ Key details

While initial demos required two RTX 5090 cards, Nvidia claims a single midrange RTX 5060 can run NBA 2K27 at 1080p with ray tracing and ultra spec DLSS 5, provided it is paired with one of the fastest gaming CPUs and 6x frame generation is enabled.

However, the technology carries a significant performance cost:

  • Nvidia estimates a performance hit of 50 to 60 percent.
  • An unofficial mod in Shadow of the Tomb Raider showed performance being cut in half.

🚀 Availability

DLSS 5 is available on RTX 50-series desktop and laptop GPUs and through GeForce Now cloud gaming.

Game Status
NBA 2K27 Launching September 3rd at 9PM PT on PC
Resident Evil Requiem Not supported
EA Sports FC Not supported
Starfield Not supported
Hogwarts Legacy Not supported

Nvidia has not answered questions regarding when the tech will come to games beyond NBA 2K27 or if previously confirmed titles will still include it.

#Nvidia #DLSS5 #RTX50-series #Gaming #AI

Source: Nvidia’s controversial DLSS 5 arrives September 3rd and requires serious GPU horsepower
